about: Each dealer's named trees (Jakob 2026-11-21: several trees per dealer, each with a name, about three at most; everything else is loose material that can later be deleted). A tree is a set of anchors from data/media-roles.json, by entry id: the root (A1) and the anchors it branches into, written in his notation by tools/dealer-tree.ts from the graph's nodes (IDLE = A1, READY = A2.1, READY-B = A2.2, READY-C = A2.3, a card node such as P4.C1 = A3P4C1). Films are not listed here: the tool finds every film whose first and last pictures are the tree's anchors. state: spelas (the game plays it), byggs (being made), vilar (resting). name is what Jakob sees and his to change. One set of hands is one tree, and one A1 may branch to several anchors at the shoe (Jakob 2026-11-26: "det enda som skiljer är väl bara att A1 kan förgrena sig till A2.1 eller A2.3"): the tree's own anchors are its first way of dealing, what the game plays when the tree is played; ways lists its further ways, each with its own anchors at the shoe of one node, and its own id, name and state, which the game (?trad=<id>), the compositions and Bordet take as a tree's. A film placed in the tree goes to the way whose anchor at the shoe it stands on; a film on none of them (rest, talk, the hole card) is the tree's and every way's. opening: a media-roles film outside the bank that leads into the root (the film before the game, /trailer). An anchor may carry seat (1-7) when its picture is seen from that seat instead of the straight camera; the tool then writes S2-A2.2. seat is set only where a register says the angle. The straight camera is seat 4's: the tree's nodes, its 36 steps, its number and what the game plays are that camera's, and an anchor with another seat, with the films that stand on it, is the same tree from that seat's camera (Karta's camera strip, ?kamera=2), never played as a straight film. markOf: the anchor is the same picture as the one named, with only the card's mark in the shoe's window changed (Jakob 2026-11-26): the same node, so the films on the one are never older for the other, and Karta shows the one that holds in Material. A tree is measured against his measure (src/dealer-trees.ts, 'en giv per kort'): 36 steps from its first A2.x anchor, the anchor at the shoe; its other A2.x anchors of its own stand in for it where the game plays their film (the Casino gives P6C1 from A2.2). The first anchor given for a node is the node's picture. Read by tools/dealer-tree.ts, which writes its report to .runtime/dealer-trad/ and serves GET /api/trees to Karta. shares (a tree that plays another's anchors and films) is still read but no tree uses it since Ingången became the Casino's opening (2026-11-26).

trees.name: Casino
trees.note: The older hands, resting since Jakob 2026-11-24 ("vi ska köra enbart med hennes nya händer och de tatuerade klippen"); the game played it until then, and ?trad=casino still does. Every film of this tree was made from these pictures, and the tree keeps them, although Jakob archived paow-vila-ung-2 and paow-ankare-2-2-t1 in Material (2026-11-23). Its A2.2 is used by one step: the deal to P6C1, whose Primär starts there. The way in through the film before the game (/trailer) was the tree Ingången, which played this tree's anchors and films with the opening first; Jakob 2026-11-26: "Casino skulle vi kunna radera som nodträd då denna nog är identisk mot Ingången eller vice versa", so it is this tree's opening. A film that ends on the tattooed A1 is not made yet.

trees.name: Tatuerad

ways.name: Tatuerad nyp
ways.note: The tattooed way where she pinches the card, from A2.1 (Jakob 2026-11-24: "Det gamla 2.1-ankaret är när hon nyper"; her smaller hands, faster, with the tattoos). A tree of its own until 2026-11-26 (Jakob: "Tatuerad och Tatuerad nyp så att säga blir en och samma"); its id, name and state are kept, so ?trad=tatuerad-nyp and the compositions play it as before. A2.1 paow-nyp-tatuerad (Jakob 2026-11-23 in Beslut: ja on tatuerat-a21-kandidat) is the last frame of the film from A1 to the shoe, paow-ingang-2-1-tatuerad-01. paow-nyp-tatuerad-marke is the same picture with the card's mark in the shoe's window (Jakob 2026-11-26 in Beslut: ja on a21-marke, new films from A2.1 are made from it): the films on paow-nyp-tatuerad stay this way's. Its deals are made from that anchor through the doll (seat 4 first, then 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7): a film ordered from either picture is this way's by its first picture, whatever tree the order named.

trees.note: What the game plays since 2026-11-24 (Jakob: "vi ska köra enbart med hennes nya händer och de tatuerade klippen"), from its first way: A2.3, where she pushes the card out (Jakob 2026-11-21; 2026-11-24: "A2.3 så skjuter hon ut kort"). A1 paow-vila-tatuerad; A2.3 paow-ankare-2-3-d with two hands, the anchor at the shoe, her gaze down on the card (Jakob 2026-11-23 in Beslut: "Ja, byt blicken"). It has no A2.2: he archived paow-ankare-2-2-blick-a in Material 2026-11-23 ("Ser inte att den används"), and no film of the tree started there. paow-ankare-2-3-c was the A2.3 until then, the same picture with her gaze to the side: it stays among the anchors, after the one that holds, so that the films that begin or end on it stay in the tree until they are remade. paow-ankare-2-3-marke is paow-ankare-2-3-d changed only in the shoe's window (no white round the card, the mark on the yellow side); it holds in Material since 2026-11-23, so a new order starts on it, and the films in the bank that start on paow-ankare-2-3-d are the same node's. The tree has no A3: he archived the landing pictures 2026-11-24 ("Arkivera - landningsbilderna - ja!"); giv and return in one film needs none. Its second way, Tatuerad nyp, deals from her tattooed A2.1 on the same A1; how often each way is played is his choice in a composition (Tatuerad: skjut + nyp).
